location.title: Where to forecast?
location.description: Step 1 of 3 — RainSoon uses Open-Meteo (free, no API key).

data_description.location_mode: Most users should pick Home Assistant home location.
data_description.location: Only if you chose map — pin your yard or city.

language.title: Integration language
language.description: Step 2 of 3 — language for Alexa messages, alert text, and weather descriptions (independent of Home Assistant UI language).

preset.title: How should we alert you?
preset.description: Step 3 of 3 — pick a profile. When unsure, choose **Balanced**.

data_description.preset: You can change this later under Options.

thresholds.title: Custom tuning
thresholds.description: Only if you chose **Custom**. RainSoon alerts on the first hour where probability AND rain exceed the limits below.

data_description.lookahead_hours: How many hours from now we scan — not a physical window. Recommended: 12–24.
data_description.probability_threshold: e.g. 50 = alert when hourly forecast is at least 50%.
data_description.precipitation_threshold_mm: e.g. 0.1 filters drizzle; 0.5 needs heavier rain.

reconfigure.title: RainSoon — settings
reconfigure.description: Change language, profile, or numbers. Location only changes if you remove and re-add the integration.

data_description.language: Messages and condition names use this language.
data_description.preset: Pick a profile or **Custom** to edit numbers.
data_description.precipitation_threshold_mm: mm/h limit on the alert hour.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often we poll the API.
